original_test_intent: Verify the SMBIOS Type 1 Family identifies the approved product family above the SKU/Product Name level, is not a field from another structure, and persists after reboot.
original_method: Collect full Type 1, parse the record-scoped Family and correlate its hierarchy with Manufacturer, Product Name and SKU, compare to the product taxonomy, run the approved reboot and repeat.
manual_activity: A user approves the product taxonomy and reboot plan. Collection, hierarchical identity comparison and reboot are automatable.
safety_requirements: Preserve full Type 1/errors and scope Family to System Information.
Do not substitute CPU family, chassis family or another record's label.
Stop on taxonomy/SKU inconsistency, placeholder, drift or reboot failure.
agent_execution_scope: Collect Type 1/tool/product identity, compare record-scoped Family and its Product/SKU relationship before/after reboot.
Do not modify DMI, invent taxonomy mappings or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve family taxonomy, aliases and Product/SKU mapping.
Resolve branding/hierarchy discrepancies and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: dmidecode -t 1 is appropriate, but generic grep needs record scoping; filtered output, hidden errors and insecure transport are insufficient.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive full sudo dmidecode -t 1 and tool version/errors via approved transport, then parse Family inside the System Information record before/after reboot.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Type 1 script, Family scope and 5/5-minute values are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Compare Type 1 Family against a versioned hierarchy of Manufacturer, Family, Product Name and SKU, while retaining full record evidence across reboot.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, dmidecode, BIOS and taxonomy revision.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Approved product identity taxonomy and installed dmidecode documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds hierarchical meaning and prevents unscoped Family matches.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Customer branding may redefine Family independently of internal platform codename; the approved taxonomy governs.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve a customer family alias, but must retain the hierarchy mapping and exact tested product/SKU.
expected_evidence: Approval, expected Family/taxonomy, asset/product/SKU mapping and tool version
Raw pre-reboot Type 1 plus hierarchy evaluation
